title: AI-Driven Human Task Substitution: Evidence from Google Translate and ChatGPT
eligible_reason: Every regression in the replication code is a Poisson pseudo-maximum-likelihood model (ppmlhdfe), which is a nonlinear estimator excluded by the protocol; there are no linear TWFE or modern-estimator specifications. The GNMT setting is a staggered binary design (three rollout cohorts plus never-treated language pairs), but the ChatGPT setting is a single adoption date.
design_notes: GNMT analysis: balanced language-pair x month panel (GNMT_market.dta: 146 language pairs x 17 months, Jan 2016-May 2017). Treatment postreatment = 1 at or after the language pair's GNMT rollout; cohorts treat1_flag (Nov 2016, 8 pairs), treat2_flag (Mar 2017, 6 pairs), treat3_flag (Apr 2017, 22 pairs); 110 never-treated pairs; 118 treated pair-months. Tables 1-3 (01_main_analyses.do lines 72-76 and following): ppmlhdfe <count or amount> postreatment, a(mdate language_id) vce(cluster language_id). Event studies (section 6, lines 340-500) are ppmlhdfe with F_10..F_2, L_0..L_6 leads and lags. Tables 4-5 are CEM-matched versions. Table 6 is an individual (freelancer) x month Poisson DiD. ChatGPT analysis: language x month panel Jan 2022-May 2023 with a single treatment date (Nov 2022) and 'performance' tasks as the comparison, estimated with ppmlhdfe and language x treatment FE. No reghdfe/regress/csdid/did_imputation calls anywhere in the do file.

ineligible_main_text_specs.reason: Poisson (ppmlhdfe); ChatGPT panel has a single adoption date

n_adoption_cohorts_note: GNMT rollout cohorts Nov 2016, Mar 2017, Apr 2017 (8, 6 and 22 language pairs); ChatGPT has one date
data_files_note: Despite the README stating the final .dta panels are not distributed, data/final/GNMT_market.dta (2,482 x 12), ChatGPT_market.dta, GNMT_individual.dta and ChatGPT_individual.dta are present in the package, as are the intermediate CEM and sample files; raw JSON platform export is not included.
software_detail: Stata (ppmlhdfe, reghdfe-style absorb, esttab to .rtf) for all regressions; Python for panel construction and Figure 1
screener_notes: Not eligible because all published estimates are Poisson. The GNMT market panel in the package would support a linear TWFE/CSA re-analysis (idname = language_id, tname = mdate, gname = cohort rollout month, never-treated present), but there is no published linear estimate to compare against, so it falls outside the protocol.
